footnotes.html: The last row of this determinant has $\bra{\phi_n}\hat{H}\ket{\phi_1}$ in its second column, not $\bra{\phi_1}\hat{H}\ket{\phi_1}$. The same slip recurs in the simplified determinant below and in the matrix of $\hat{H}$.
$\braket{\phi_n|\phi_m} = \delta_{nm}$ needs the basis functions to be orthonormal, normalized and orthogonal to each other.
The basis runs from $\phi_0$ to $\phi_n$, so the determinant has $n + 1$ rows and gives $n + 1$ values of $E$, each with a set of $n + 1$ coefficients.
